queries: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT s.healtheval, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM scanconservation AS c JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY s.healtheval), shares AS (SELECT record_count, record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share FROM status_counts), compared AS (SELECT record_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT AVG(record_count) AS average_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share;
